subject: Re: Model regression after v2.1.3 rollout — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@retailco.com>, Priya Rao <p.rao@retailco.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Model evaluation follow-up and recommended next steps

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning — good overview of your search & recommendations use cases and the examples you shared. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

Recap
- Primary goal: reduce false positives in search intent and improve entity extraction correctness for product titles (top-funnel NLU).
- Current production model: v2.1.3 (rolled 2027-09-09).
- Baseline model we benchmarked previously: v2.0.9 (stable for RetailCo in our June runs).

What we’re recommending now
1) Short term: pin RetailCo traffic to v2.0.9 while we investigate the v2.1.3 diff. This will restore previous quality while we finish root-cause.
2) Parallel evaluation: run the prompt set you shared (attached eval_promptset.jsonl) across v2.0.9 and v2.1.3 and collect metric deltas (precision/recall for entity extraction, NLU intent F1). I’ve included a link to the benchmark run (Drive) and a short MOP (postcall_mop.docx) with steps.
3) If we confirm a regression we’ll either pin v2.0.9 or push a targeted patch to v2.1.x — aim to have a timeline within 48 hours once we have diffs.

Attachments: eval_promptset.jsonl (your prompt set), postcall_mop.docx (internal MOP for rollback/eval), note: I’ll drop the regression diff once Rishi completes the analysis.

Can you confirm:
- Do you want us to proceed with an immediate pin to v2.0.9 for RetailCo traffic?
- Do you prefer a full rollback or a canary (10% traffic) while we run additional checks?

I’ll start prepping a rollback plan (we can schedule for tomorrow morning PT if you want).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
https://redwood.ai

From: Alex Harper <alex.harper@retailco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <p.rao@retailco.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model evaluation follow-up and recommended next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap. We ran a quick sweep after the v2.1.3 rollout yesterday and are seeing a notable drop in correct entity extraction for product titles — roughly a 9% hit on our precision metric for the weekly sample. We pulled a couple of concrete examples where the model now returns truncate/misclassified tokens in the product name field (see inline below).

Example: 
- Input: "Blue Ridge Waterproof Hiking Boot - Men
- Expected entity: "Blue Ridge Waterproof Hiking Boot"
- v2.0.9 output: correct
- v2.1.3 output: "Blue Ridge Waterproof"

This is impacting downstream categorization and recommendations. We’re getting customer complaints on search relevance already.

We’d like to escalate: please advise immediate mitigation. I’m ok with a full rollback to v2.0.9 if that’s lowest risk. If there’s any way to do a canary and validate quickly (within a few hours) that would also work.

I’ve attached the small CSV with diffs we exported from our side — hope it helps.

—Alex
Alex Harper
Sr. Product Manager, Search
RetailCo
alex.harper@retailco.com | +1 212-555-0606

On Fri, Sep 10, 2027 at 09:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alex / Priya —
> 
> Thanks again for the call this morning — good overview of your search & recommendations use cases...

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@retailco.com>, Priya Rao <p.rao@retailco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model regression after v2.1.3 rollout — initial analysis + rollback plan

Hi Alex / team —

I pulled the logs and ran the retail prompt set (the eval_promptset.jsonl) across both v2.0.9 and v2.1.3 this morning. Preliminary findings:

- Confirmed regression: entity extraction precision down ~8.7% (sample size ~1,200). Intent F1 also down ~3.2%.
- Root cause hypothesis: v2.1.3 includes a tokenizer change and an optimized kernel path for longer context that slightly alters tokenization boundaries for hyphenated product names and some punctuation-heavy titles. This produces shorter extracted spans in a subset of cases.

What I recommend as an immediate mitigation:
1) Pin RetailCo traffic to model v2.0.9 via per-account routing (this is a config change on your account route). Pin will take effect within 5–10 minutes after we flip the route.
2) Start a 10% canary of v2.1.3 (isolated) to collect more debug traces and allow us to reproduce locally.
3) I’ve attached model_regression_diff_v2.1.3_vs_v2.0.9.csv with representative examples + tokenization deltas.

Rollback/pinning command (platform API):
- Pin (example):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/RC-2027-0910/routing 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
    -d '{"pin_model":"v2.0.9","effective":"immediate"}'

- Canary (10%):
  curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/RC-2027-0910/routing 
    -d '{"route_policy":{"percentages":{"v2.0.9":90,"v2.1.3":10}}}'

Next steps / timeline:
- If Alex confirms, we’ll pin RetailCo to v2.0.9 now and start a 10% canary to collect traces.
- I’ll run the full eval suite (benchmarks link below) and push a minimal patch to v2.1.x if we can reproduce and fix the tokenizer split quickly. Expect ~24–48 hours for a patch & validation.

Links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/retailco-evallogs
- Benchmark run: https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/retailco-run-2027-09-10

Attachments: model_regression_diff_v2.1.3_vs_v2.0.9.csv

I’ll standby for confirmation to proceed with the pin.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0144

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Harper <alex.harper@retailco.com>, Priya Rao <p.rao@retailco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model regression after v2.1.3 rollout — next steps (scheduling rollback)

Alex —

Thanks for the quick signal and the diffs — this is actionable. Per Rishi’s analysis we will proceed as follows unless you tell us otherwise: 

Action items (owners + ETA)
- Marissa: schedule the rollback/pin to v2.0.9 for RetailCo — proposed window Tue 2027-09-13 10:00 AM PT (will send calendar invite) — DONE (tentative).
- Rishi: implement pin + start 10% canary trace collection immediately after pin — ETA: within 15 min of the pin.
- David: prepare note on potential commercial remediation (credits) if rollback impacts billing during window — ETA: EOD today.
- Alex / Priya: confirm whether you want a full rollback or we should do pin + canary. If no reply by 9/13 08:00 AM PT we will perform the pin + canary.

I’ve attached the MOP (postcall_mop.docx) and the prompt set we used. Rishi attached the diff CSV as well. We’ll monitor logs and share a short daily summary until we push a final patch.

One-off details: if you prefer a hard rollback rather than per-account pin, we can do that as well — it’s just more disruptive across other customers. Pinning gives the clean isolation for you.

Thanks everyone — we’ll keep this tight and transparent.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
